title: fix/ubuntu-desktop-installer-shutdown → ubuntu/master
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index c6f72ee..e5a4360 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+livecd-rootfs (26.10.20) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Stop the live-session installer Snap scope during shutdown and skip
+    settings restoration after SIGTERM.
+
+ -- Chris Bainbridge <chris.bainbridge@canonical.com>  Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:50:08 +0100
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.19) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   [ Valentin Haudiquet ]
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu/includes.chroot.minimal.standard.live/usr/lib/systemd/user/ubuntu-desktop-installer.service b/live-build/ubuntu/includes.chroot.minimal.standard.live/usr/lib/systemd/user/ubuntu-desktop-installer.service
index 51d7394..a8c391d 100644
--- a/live-build/ubuntu/includes.chroot.minimal.standard.live/usr/lib/systemd/user/ubuntu-desktop-installer.service
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu/includes.chroot.minimal.standard.live/usr/lib/systemd/user/ubuntu-desktop-installer.service
@@ -4,14 +4,15 @@
 Description=Ubuntu Desktop Installer
 PartOf=graphical-session.target
 After=graphical-session.target
+Before=snap.ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap.ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap-installer.service
+BindsTo=snap.ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap.ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap-installer.service
 
 # Never run in GDM
 Conflicts=gnome-session@gnome-login.target
 
 [Service]
 Type=oneshot
-# Make sure that the system was seeded to access the snap
-ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/snap wait system seed.loaded
-ExecStart=/snap/bin/ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap --try-or-install
-ExecStopPost=sh -c "gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.dash-to-dock dock-fixed true; gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.dash-to-dock intellihide true; gnome-extensions enable ding@rastersoft.com"
+RemainAfterExit=yes
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/true
+ExecStopPost=sh -c "if systemctl --user list-jobs --no-legend --no-pager graphical-session.target | grep -qE '[[:space:]]stop[[:space:]]'; then exit 0; fi; gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.dash-to-dock dock-fixed true; gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.dash-to-dock intellihide true; gnome-extensions enable ding@rastersoft.com"
 Restart=no
